messages.subject: Campus Drive: Cinder Robotics - Robotics Engineer (2026 Batch)
messages.body:
Dear Students,

Cinder Robotics is hiring Robotics Engineers (CTC 13 LPA).
Eligibility: CSE, ME, ECE | CGPA 7.0 and above | No active backlogs.
Register here: https://forms.gle/cinderRE by 11:59 PM, 26 September 2026.

Regards,
Career Office
